title: MC Dirt Edition
description:
the most easy and painful mc-modification ever
all you have to do is mine dirt, a lot of dirt
body:
features ============ this mod makes minecraft feels different, you can still play the game normaly, but you can also play the game by mining dirt (a lot of)

the totem of compeletion is really overpowered since you can get all advancements by using that. how to beat ======= first, you mine a piece of dirt, and you will be given a unlocked recipe,

second, mine more dirt (around 8) to make "Dirt 1", which is 9 dirt compress together

and then, make your own journey to mine as much dirt as possible until you made 9 "Dirt 25"

finally, use those piece of "Dirt 25" to make the totem of compeletion, but before you use it, type "/download totem_action" and hit enter, then right click to see you get all the advancements and been teleport to the end, and after a little while, the dragon is killed. misc ==== it takes me like 10min to code this, and 20min to debug, so ur free to do anything with the mod, even use the source code.
